Sandbox_TienCoolers_CoolFactor_tooltip: Rot rate for food in an iced cooler, as a fraction of normal. 0.25 means food keeps four times as long. 0 stops rot entirely. A cooler is never allowed to beat a powered fridge, so this is floored at whatever Refrigeration Effectiveness gives one.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_IceLifeHours_tooltip: In-game hours one full bag of ice lasts inside a cooler at 20 C. Hot weather burns through it faster, cold weather slower.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_IceLifeOutsideMult_t: Multiplier applied to ice lifetime when the ice is not in a cooler. 0.2 means it melts five times faster in a backpack.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_FreezeHours_tooltip: In-game hours a powered freezer needs to turn water into ice, and to refill a melted bag of ice.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_WaterPerBag_tooltip: Units of water consumed per bag of ice produced. Water pools across every container set to freeze in the same fridge, so several small ones can add up to a bag. For scale, a bottle holds 1 unit and a bucket 10.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_UseColdpacks_tooltip: Lets the vanilla Cold Pack chill a cooler too, at 40%% the strength of a bag of ice.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_SpawnIceInLoot_toolt: Adds bags of ice to freezer loot. Turn off to make freezing your own water the only source.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_ShowColdTint_tooltip: Chills the items in an iced cooler so the inventory window tints their rows blue, the same cue a powered fridge gives. Turn off to leave item temperature alone.
Sandbox_TienCoolers_RenameCoolers_toolti: Adds (Iced) to the name of a cooler that currently holds ice.
